title: Grok Bot OS API
description: Single source of truth for grokbotd. JSON-RPC 2.0 over the unix socket and POST /v1/rpc, the grokbot-os CLI and the MCP tools are all generated from this file. Every method has a scope (an OS function) and an access level (read or write); permissions are granted per caller per scope with mode allow, ask or deny (docs/OS_API.md, SECURITY.md).

x-capabilities.system.read: OS name, version, kernel, hostname, uptime, memory, bootc image
x-capabilities.windows.read: Window titles and app ids of every open window and workspace
x-capabilities.apps.read: Installed apps, web apps and launcher entries
x-capabilities.apps.write: Install, remove (always confirmed by the user) and open web apps
x-capabilities.network.read: Network interfaces, addresses and default route; wired and VPN connections
x-capabilities.lock.read: Screen lock and idle state: whether a PIN is set, locked, idle timeouts
x-capabilities.audio.read: Output and input devices, volume and mute state
x-capabilities.display.read: Display backlight brightness and night light settings
x-capabilities.notifications.read: Notification app names and summaries (never bodies) and Do Not Disturb state
x-capabilities.capture.read: Screenshot folder, file names and sizes (never image data)
x-capabilities.input.read: Keyboard input method (fcitx5): configured methods, current method, trigger keys
x-capabilities.display.write: Change display backlight brightness and night light
x-capabilities.network.write: Scan, connect to and disconnect from Wi-Fi; connect, configure and disconnect wired and VPN connections; import and delete VPN profiles
x-capabilities.notifications.write: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off
x-capabilities.power.write: Suspend, restart, shut down or lock (always confirmed by the user)
x-capabilities.lock.write: Change idle screen-off and lock timeouts
x-capabilities.input.write: Switch the Korean input method on or off
x-capabilities.camera.use: Start a camera use session (always confirmed; shows the in-use indicator)
x-capabilities.microphone.use: Start a microphone use session (always confirmed; shows the in-use indicator)
x-capabilities.privacy.read: Active camera and microphone sessions (for the in-use indicator)
x-capabilities.permissions.read: View permission grants of every caller
x-capabilities.permissions.write: Change or revoke permission grants (granting always asks the user)
x-capabilities.permissions.request: Ask the user for a scope (shows the consent prompt)
x-capabilities.files.read: List and read files in the home folder (not hidden ones)
x-capabilities.files.write: Create, change, move and trash files in the home folder (not hidden ones)
x-capabilities.mediakeys.write: Send media key presses to apps
x-capabilities.updates.read: Booted, staged and rollback OS images, update availability, health-check record
x-capabilities.updates.write: Check for, install (stage) or roll back an OS update (always confirmed)
x-capabilities.bluetooth.read: Bluetooth adapter state and paired or connected devices (names, addresses, battery)
x-capabilities.bluetooth.write: Turn Bluetooth on or off, look for nearby devices, pair, connect, disconnect, trust and remove devices
x-capabilities.storage.read: Removable drives: label, size, file system, whether and where they are open
x-capabilities.storage.write: Open (mount), close (unmount), eject, unlock and lock (LUKS) removable drives
x-capabilities.power-mode.read: Current power mode and the modes this computer offers
x-capabilities.power-mode.write: Switch power mode (power saver, balanced, performance)
x-capabilities.printing.read: Printers (CUPS queues and driverless network printers), the default printer and your print jobs
x-capabilities.printing.write: Choose the default printer, print a file from the home folder or an open USB drive, print a test page, cancel your jobs
x-capabilities.appdata.read: This app's own data folder: list and read (installed web apps only)
x-capabilities.appdata.write: This app's own data folder: write, make folders, delete (installed web apps only)

api.methods.description: List the methods of this API with their capability.

system.info.description: OS name and version, kernel, hostname, uptime, memory and the booted bootc image.

system.resources.description: CPU use (percent since the previous call), load average, memory, swap, disk space and network byte counters.

windows.list.description: Open windows from the sway tree: id, app_id, title, workspace, focused, fullscreen.

workspace.description: Only windows on this workspace name.

workspaces.list.description: Workspaces: name, number, output, focused, visible.

dock.get.description: Effective dock configuration (system defaults merged with the user's dock.conf).

wallpaper.get.description: Effective wallpaper configuration: image path, mode and color.

apps.list.description: Apps installed with grokbot-install, web apps (system and user-installed, with origin, requested scopes and icon) and the launcher entries visible to the user.

apps.install.description: Install a web app from a local bundle (directory or .zip with manifest.json) or a URL. Always shows the consent prompt with the app's name, origin and requested scopes. Adds a launcher entry (launcher and dock, never the desktop). Grants nothing: the app asks per scope.

apps.uninstall.description: Remove a user-installed web app: launcher, files, and unless keep_data, its browser profile (storage) and grants. Always shows the consent prompt. System apps cannot be removed.

apps.launch.description: Open a web app in its own app window (separate browser profile, no browser controls) on a new workspace.

power.status.description: Batteries (capacity, status) and whether AC power is online.

network.status.description: Network interfaces (state, MAC, addresses) and the default route.

lock.status.description: Screen lock and idle state: PIN set (never the PIN), locked now, swayidle running, screen-off and lock timeouts in seconds.

audio.status.description: Default output and input volume (percent) and mute state from PipeWire (wpctl).

display.brightness.description: Backlight devices with brightness, max_brightness and percent. Empty on desktops and VMs.

notifications.list.description: Visible notifications (id, app, summary, urgency; never the body), whether mako runs and whether Do Not Disturb is on. include_history adds the dismissed ones.

capture.status.description: Screenshot folder, number of PNG files, the newest `limit` (name, size, mtime) and whether grim, slurp and wl-copy are installed. Never returns image data.

input.status.description: Input method state: fcitx5 running, current method (e.g. hangul), whether it is active, configured methods, trigger keys and XMODIFIERS. Never keystrokes.

audio.set.description: Set output or input volume and/or mute: the default device (target) or one device by id from audio.devices.list.

display.set_brightness.description: Set backlight brightness in percent (1-100; never fully dark).

display.nightlight.status.description: Night light (warmer colours, gammastep): enabled, temperature (K), schedule (always or custom between from and to, HH:MM), and whether it is available and running.

display.nightlight.set.description: Change night light. Omitted fields keep their value. Saved in ~/.config/grokbot/nightlight.json and applied at once (user unit grokbot-nightlight.service).

network.wifi.list.description: Visible Wi-Fi networks (SSID, signal, security, in use) via NetworkManager.

network.wifi.connect.description: Connect to a Wi-Fi network (nmcli). The password is passed to NetworkManager through a 0600 file, never logged or put on a command line.

network.wifi.disconnect.description: Disconnect a Wi-Fi device (default: the connected one).

notifications.set_dnd.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off.

power.action.description: Suspend, reboot, power off or lock. Always shows the consent prompt, for every caller.

lock.set_idle.description: Set idle timeouts in seconds (0 = off) in ~/.config/grokbot/idle.conf and restart the idle watcher.

input.set.description: Turn the Korean input method on (active=true) or off (fcitx5-remote).

capture.screenshot.description: Take a full-screen screenshot into the screenshot folder; returns the file name and size, never image data.

camera.session.start.description: Ask to use the camera. Always prompts; while the session is open the dock shows the camera-in-use indicator. Returns a session id.

microphone.session.start.description: Ask to use the microphone. Always prompts; while the session is open the dock shows the microphone-in-use indicator. Returns a session id.

media.session.stop.description: End a camera or microphone session (the caller's own; the local user may end any).

privacy.status.description: Open camera and microphone sessions (who, what, since when) for the in-use indicator.

permissions.list.description: Effective mode (allow/ask/deny) per scope for every known caller, with stored grants.

permissions.whoami.description: Who the daemon thinks the caller is: the principal grants are bound to. Unix socket callers are identified by the kernel (SO_PEERCRED pid -> systemd unit or executable/script), not by x-client.

permissions.set.description: Store a mode for one caller and one scope. Always shows the consent prompt. camera, microphone and power cannot be set to allow.

permissions.revoke.description: Remove stored grants of a caller (one scope, or all). The caller falls back to the system default.

permissions.request.description: Ask the user to grant the calling origin one scope. Shows the consent prompt; the answer is stored (always: allow, once: ask, deny: deny). Rate-limited.

audit.list.description: Recent audit log entries, newest last. Filters: principal, decision, method, access.

access.description: Only reads or only writes (the dock's status polling is reads).

files.list.description: List a folder in the home folder (hidden entries are left out and counted). With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.stat.description: Type, size, mtime and MIME type of one file or folder. With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.read.description: Read a file (max 16 MB) as UTF-8 text or base64. With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.write.description: Create or (with overwrite) replace a file, atomically. Max 16 MB. With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.mkdir.description: Create a folder. With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.move.description: Rename or move a file or folder inside the home folder. With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

to.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

files.trash.description: Move a file or folder to the trash (~/.local/share/Trash). With volume: on that open removable drive instead.

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Documents/a.txt ("/" is ~). Hidden names are refused.

volume.description: Removable drive id from storage.list (must be open). Paths are then relative to the drive instead of the home folder.

media.keys.wait.description: Wait up to timeout seconds (max 55) for a media key; returns {key} or {key:null}. The newest waiter receives the key.

media.keys.press.description: Deliver a media key to the app waiting for it (used by the sway key bindings). Returns delivered=false when no app is waiting.

update.status.description: Booted / staged / rollback images (image, version, digest, timestamp), whether an update is available (from the last check), restart_needed, running actions, the last action's result and the post-update health record (last_good, last_check, rolled_back).

update.check.description: Start `bootc upgrade --check` (download the manifest only). Returns at once; poll update.status. Always prompts.

update.apply.description: Start `bootc upgrade`: download and stage the new image. It boots at the next restart; the current image stays as rollback. Never reboots. Always prompts.

Install an OS update (used at next restart)

update.rollback.description: Start `bootc rollback`: the previous image boots at the next restart. Never reboots. Always prompts.
x-title: 이전 OS로 되돌리기(다음 시작 때 적용)
Roll back to the previous OS image (at next restart)

display.list.description: Outputs (monitors) from sway: name, make/model, active, scale, position, current mode and offered modes; plus the saved per-output settings.

display.set.description: Change one output: scale (0.5-4, 1/8 steps), position (x, y in layout pixels), mode, or enabled. Applies now and is saved (~/.config/grokbot/outputs.conf). Turning off the last active screen is refused.

bluetooth.status.description: Bluetooth adapters (powered, discovering) and known devices: paired, trusted or connected, with battery when the device reports it. available=false when there is no adapter; service=false when bluetoothd is not running.

bluetooth.set_power.description: Turn the Bluetooth adapter on or off. Turning on also lifts a soft rfkill block.

bluetooth.scan.description: Look for nearby Bluetooth devices for a few seconds and return the ones that are not paired yet, strongest signal first.

bluetooth.pair.description: Pair with a device found by bluetooth.scan, mark it trusted (it may reconnect by itself) and connect it. Devices that need a PIN or passkey are not supported yet and return an error. PIN/passkey: grokbotd's pairing agent asks you to confirm the code (consent prompt) or tells you what to type on the device.

pin.description: PIN or passkey for devices that ask for one to be typed (old keyboards, car kits). Passkey confirmation and codes to type on the device are asked/shown with the consent prompt instead.

bluetooth.trust.description: Trust or untrust a device. A trusted device may connect by itself.

bluetooth.remove.description: Forget a device: unpair and remove it.

audio.devices.list.description: Output (speakers, headphones, Bluetooth) and input (microphones) devices: id, description, default, bluetooth, volume_percent, muted. PipeWire (pw-dump, wpctl).

audio.set_default.description: Make a device (id from audio.devices.list) the default output or input. Playing streams move to it.

storage.list.description: Removable volumes (USB sticks, SD cards, external disks; never the system disk): id (block device, e.g. sdb1), name, label, drive, fs, size, mounted, mount_points, read_only, ejectable. available=false when udisks2 is not running. Encrypted (LUKS) drives are listed with encrypted/locked; an unlocked one appears as its own volume with backing = the container id. exFAT and NTFS are mounted like other file systems.

storage.mount.description: Open (mount) a removable volume under /run/media/<user>/. Returns the volume with its mount point.

storage.unmount.description: Close (unmount) a removable volume; with eject=true also unmount the drive's other volumes and eject or power it off so it can be pulled out safely.

storage.unlock.description: Unlock an encrypted (LUKS) removable drive. The passphrase is typed by the user into the secure prompt (never a parameter, never logged); answering it is the consent. With mount (default true) the unlocked file system is opened too. Returns the unlocked volume.

storage.lock.description: Close an unlocked encrypted drive: unmount its file system and lock the LUKS container (id = the unlocked volume).

power.profile.status.description: Power mode: active (power-saver, balanced or performance), profiles offered here, degraded (why performance is limited, e.g. high temperature). available=false without the power-profiles service.

power.profile.set.description: Switch power mode. The mode must be one this computer offers.

keyboard.layout.status.description: Keyboard layout: the chosen layout id, what sway reports as active, whether Korean input (fcitx5 hangul) is configured, and the layouts that can be chosen.

keyboard.layout.set.description: Choose the keyboard layout (one of keyboard.layout.status available). Applies now in sway, is saved (~/.config/grokbot/keyboard.conf) and is set as the fcitx5 keyboard layout with Korean (hangul) kept, so 한/영 keeps working.

layout.description: Layout id, e.g. us, kr, us-dvorak, de

network.connections.list.description: Wired (ethernet) and VPN (WireGuard, OpenVPN) connections from NetworkManager: name, uuid, kind, device, active, IPv4 settings of wired ones, ethernet devices and cable state, active VPN names. Never secrets.

network.connection.up.description: Connect a wired or VPN connection (nmcli connection up).

network.connection.down.description: Disconnect a wired or VPN connection (nmcli connection down).

network.wired.configure.description: Set IPv4 of a wired connection: automatic (DHCP) or manual address/prefix, gateway in the same network and DNS servers. Reconnects it when active.

network.vpn.import.description: Import a VPN profile from a file in the home folder: WireGuard .conf or OpenVPN .ovpn (files-scope path rules: no hidden paths, nothing outside ~).

path.description: Path inside the home folder, e.g. /Downloads/office.conf

printers.list.description: Printers from CUPS (configured queues and driverless IPP Everywhere / AirPrint printers found on the network), which one is the default, and your print jobs.

printers.set_default.description: Make a printer your default (lpoptions -d, per user).

print.file.description: Print a file from the home folder, or from an open USB drive with volume (files-scope path rules: no hidden paths, nothing outside the root). Up to 64 MB.

print.job.cancel.description: Cancel one of your print jobs (id from printers.list jobs).

appdata.list.description: Entries of a folder in the calling web app's own data folder (~/.local/share/grokbot/app-data/<app id>/), plus used bytes and quota. Only installed web apps; the app is identified by its origin.

path.description: Path inside the calling app's own data folder, e.g. todos.json or /notes/a.txt ("/" is the folder). '..', '.' and symlinks are refused.

appdata.read.description: Read a file from the calling app's own data folder. Max 16 MB.

path.description: Path inside the calling app's own data folder, e.g. todos.json or /notes/a.txt ("/" is the folder). '..', '.' and symlinks are refused.

appdata.write.description: Write a file in the calling app's own data folder, atomically (replaces by default; overwrite=false refuses). parents (default true) creates missing folders. Max 16 MB per file, 100 MB per app.

path.description: Path inside the calling app's own data folder, e.g. todos.json or /notes/a.txt ("/" is the folder). '..', '.' and symlinks are refused.

appdata.mkdir.description: Make a folder (and its parents) in the calling app's own data folder.

path.description: Path inside the calling app's own data folder, e.g. todos.json or /notes/a.txt ("/" is the folder). '..', '.' and symlinks are refused.

appdata.delete.description: Delete a file or (recursive=true) a folder in the calling app's own data folder. Symlinks are removed, never followed.

path.description: Path inside the calling app's own data folder, e.g. todos.json or /notes/a.txt ("/" is the folder). '..', '.' and symlinks are refused.
